components.text:
A new upgrade not present in earlier versions of the mod. Effect: grants the Luck attribute, improving loot table rolls, fishing, and similar luck-based mechanics, up to +10 Luck across 5 levels.
This upgrade is still a work in progress on this branch - its intended training method (partly tied to Demon Dungeon loot) isn't fully wired up yet, so treat its acquisition path as unconfirmed for now.
